body:
@StefanStojanovic 
Because of conflict, I checked and tracked the change code,
I Think closing this PR as the issue has already been fixed in upstream via PR #59847


The upstream fix uses a simpler approach: `if (slashCheck && !path.ToStringView().ends_with("\\"))` which achieves the same result with less code.
